title: Cubing Method Stage
description: Schema for a single stage of a solving method (e.g. CFOP OLL). One JSON file = one stage.

stage_name.description: Human-readable stage name (e.g. 'Permutation of the Last Layer').

notation.description: Move notation system used in algorithm strings.

description.description: Optional prose description of the stage.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier unique within the stage.

aliases.description: Other names this case is known by.

number.description: Standard numbering within the stage where one exists (e.g. OLL 1-57).

setup.description: Scramble (WCA notation) that produces this case from a solved cube. Applying any of the algorithms to the resulting state should solve it back.

recognition.description: Notes on how to recognize this case visually.

algorithms.description: All known algorithms for this case, ordered by popularity (most popular first).

examples: R U R' U R U2 R'
R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'

auf_pre.description: Optional pre-AUF (Adjust U Face) move if recognition is rotation-dependent.

auf_post.description: Optional post-AUF move after the algorithm.

popularity.description: Coarse popularity tier. 'primary' = the canonical/most-used alg for this case.

popularity_rank.description: Optional numeric ranking within this case (1 = most popular).

popularity_source.description: Where the popularity judgment came from (e.g. 'algdb.net votes', 'jperm.net recommended', 'curator').

best_for.description: What this algorithm is especially well-suited for.

length_htm.description: Move count in Half Turn Metric.

length_stm.description: Move count in Slice Turn Metric.

length_qtm.description: Move count in Quarter Turn Metric.

author.description: Who is credited with the algorithm, if known.

source_urls.description: Where this algorithm was sourced from.

notes.description: Prose notes: fingertricks, regrips, when to prefer this variant.

diagram.description: How to render the case's cube state diagram.

style.description: Diagram style. 'last-layer' = top-down view showing only the U face and top stickers of side faces. 'full' = full cube net.

stickers.description: Sticker colors by face position, when overriding derivation from the setup scramble. Keys are face letters (U/F/R/B/L/D); values are arrays of 9 color codes ('w','y','r','o','b','g','-' for hidden/gray).

arrows.description: PLL-style arrows showing piece movement. Each arrow is {from, to} where positions reference sticker grid indices.

svg_path.description: Relative path to the pre-generated SVG (filled in by the diagram-generation tool).
